Introduction

David “Yungin” Kim is a Korean-American, x3 Grammy-winning mix engineer, producer & rapper known for his work on iconic projects like Kendrick Lamar’s 'To Pimp a Butterfly', Nipsey Hussle’s 'Racks in the Middle', and Nas’s 'King’s Disease'. He officially debuted in April 2024 under AimKorea with the single "No Lowkey" featuring Jessi & CAMO.

Born in Seoul and trained at the Musicians Institute in Los Angeles, he began his career as an unpaid intern at Chalice Recording Studios, eventually becoming their head engineer. Kim later joined acclaimed producer Hit-Boy and has since worked with top artists including Ariana Grande, Post Malone, DJ Khaled, and Big Sean.

Beyond his work in the US, he’s made major contributions to the Korean music industry, engineering for BTS members RM, Jimin, and j-hope, as well as Taeyang, Kai, and Zico. Operating between L.A. and Seoul, Kim has become a key figure in bridging Western and Korean music, shaping the global sound of modern pop and hip-hop.
